svg.title: Three candidate models compared on accuracy, macro-F1 and flip-rate
svg.desc: Three hand-drawn cards labelled model A, model B and model C. Each card lists its own metrics with a bar beneath. Model A: accuracy 0.924, macro-F1 0.925, flip-rate 0.613 with a full bar. Model B: accuracy 0.907, macro-F1 0.908, flip-rate 0.000 with an empty track. Model C: accuracy 0.818, macro-F1 0.816, flip-rate 0.000 with an empty track. Accuracy and macro-F1 are marked with an up arrow for higher is better, flip-rate with a down arrow.
